daily.today_energy: Mars and Jupiter are both in your sign, Leo, and they're vibing together hard. You've got serious momentum today—your confidence isn't just showing up, it's taking up space. Channel this into stuff that actually matters to you.
daily.love: Venus in Libra is playing nice with Jupiter, so your charm is naturally elevated. If you're coupled up, this is a solid day for real conversations. Single? People are noticing. Keep it genuine though—the vibe is authentic connection, not performance.
daily.career: With Mars conjunct Jupiter in Leo, you're ready to pitch ideas or take on leadership. The Moon squaring Mars might make some people a little tense, so lead with clarity, not intensity. You've got the firepower; use it strategically.
daily.health: That Mars-Jupiter energy can make you feel invincible, but pace yourself. Great day for movement or exercise that feels empowering. Just don't overdo it thinking you're unbreakable. Balance the intensity with actual rest.

weekly.overview: Leo, this week is basically your time to flex. Mars conjuncts Jupiter in your sign early week—expect major confidence and momentum. Best Day: Tuesday (Mars-Jupiter energy peaks). Watch-Out Day: Thursday when Mars shifts into Virgo, pulling some of that fire inward. The Moon hits your sign midweek for an emotional reset. This is about channeling intensity into something real, not just vibes.
weekly.love: Early week is *the* window for bold moves—Mars-Jupiter has you magnetic and magnetic energy is attractive. Midweek, the Leo Moon softens things; lean into vulnerability if you're coupled up. By weekend, Mars dips into Virgo, so the flirtation phase ends and you'll want actual substance. Quality over quantity, babe.
weekly.career: Tuesday is your power day—Mars conjunct Jupiter hands you ambition on a platter. Use it to pitch ideas, ask for that raise, or take charge of a project. Midweek feels dreamy but productive; the Moon in your sign sharpens your instincts. Thursday onwards, Mars in Virgo shifts you into execution mode—time to actually *do* the work, not just plan it.
weekly.health: Your energy is HIGH early week (Mars-Jupiter), so channel it into workouts or movement you actually enjoy. Midweek might feel emotionally intense—journal it out. By Thursday, Mars into Virgo asks for routine and discipline. This isn't burnout; it's about building sustainable habits that stick.
